summary: Iteration 6 — Frontend-only validation of HomeIVF CRM Call-Center Phase 2 (Auto-Dialer Logic Brief §4/§5/§7). All 6 review-request cases PASS end-to-end against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with admin@homeivf.com. (1) AGENT STATUS SWITCHER: data-testid='agent-status-switcher' + 'agent-status-button' render in header on every page; opens 'agent-status-menu'; all 7 options present (agent-status-option-available/-on-call/-lunch-break/-washroom-break/-refreshment-break/-meeting/-offline). Selecting 'Lunch Break' updates the button label to 'Lunch Break' and survives full page reload (persisted via POST/GET /api/agent/status). Reset to 'Available' at the end. (2) CALL CENTER NAV: sidebar 'nav-call-center' navigates to /call-center which renders 'call-center-page' + as admin shows all 4 tabs (cc-tab-call-logs, cc-tab-missed-calls, cc-tab-agent-live-status, cc-tab-break-reports). (3) CALL LOGS tab: 'call-list-table' rendered with 4 rows (call-list-row-<id>) covering all 9 columns; MISSED CALLS tab shows the friendly empty state 'No missed calls 🎉' (table=0, rows=0) — works correctly. (4) AGENT LIVE STATUS tab: 'agent-live-grid' renders with 28 'agent-live-<id>' cards (one per active agent) each showing name, colored status dot and 'Break today' time; 'agent-live-refresh' button reloads (28 cards persist). (5) BREAK REPORTS tab: 'break-report-date' input renders with today as default (2026-06-24), 'break-report-table' present with 1 'break-row-<id>'. (6) DISPOSITION POPUP (§4): set admin user's ozonetel_agent_id='QADISPO1' via PATCH /api/users/1; POSTed /api/calls/ozonetel/screenpop?phoneNumber=9990001212&ucid=QADISP49254&agentID=QADISPO1 → 200 (call_id=63, user_id=1). Within ~5s on /dashboard, 'incoming-call-banner' appeared with 'banner-phone' = '9990001212', all 4 disposition buttons present (disposition-interested/-not-interested/-call-back-later/-converted). Clicked 'disposition-converted' → 'disposition-note' textarea + 'disposition-save' button appeared. Saved with note 'QA test - auto closed' → toast 'Logged: Converted' shown (verified) and banner closed (count=0). CLEANED UP: cleared admin's ozonetel_agent_id (PATCH 200, verified null) and reset agent status to Available.

critical_code_review_comments: §5 STATUS SYSTEM: AgentStatusSwitcher correctly persists via /api/agent/status (POST) and rehydrates via /api/agent/me (GET) — status survives reload. All 7 status values per the Brief render with distinct colored dots. ✓

§7 CALL CENTER VIEWS: CallCenter.jsx cleanly tabbed; CallList works for both Call Logs and Missed Calls (status filter); AgentLive uses 15-second polling; BreakReports filters status-logs by date & breaks_only=true. Manager/admin gating (`isMgr`) correctly hides Agent Live and Break Reports tabs from caller role. ✓

§4 INCOMING BANNER: IncomingCallBanner polls /api/calls/active every 5s and renders a non-blocking floating popup. Dismissed-call dedupe via useRef set (`dismissedRef`) is a nice touch — prevents the banner re-appearing for an already-handled call. Save flow correctly posts to /api/calls/<id>/disposition with disposition + note + (conditionally) follow_up_date, then toasts and dismisses. ✓
BANNER PHONE DISPLAY: 'banner-phone' shows the raw 10-digit phone ('9990001212') when the caller doesn't match a lead. May want to format as +91-prefixed/grouped for readability. Cosmetic only.

POLLING FREQUENCY: 5s polling for /api/calls/active for every logged-in user is fine at this scale but consider switching to a long-poll or Server-Sent Events / WebSocket when agent count grows, to reduce backend QPS and battery drain on idle tabs.
